caveats: Pareto objectives: minimize GPU MiB, maximize TG tokens/s, minimize KLD. Only rows with all three objectives are eligible; exact ties all remain optimal. Budget fit is GPU MiB <= the budget, independent of quality availability. Global and budget frontiers are descriptive pooled comparisons, not transferable claims. Class frontiers compare rows only within their labelled class. Discrete-only, mixed and unclassified measurements do not establish transferable savings. No statistical significance is established; workloads, hardware, memory accounting and quality references must be comparable.
